sloka: तस्मिन् हते देवरिपौ त्रिशीर्षे हनूमता शक्रपराक्रमेण।नेदुः प्लवङ्गाः प्रचचाल भूमी रक्षांस्यथो दुद्रुविरे समन्तात् ।। ६.७०.४९ ।।
transliteration: tasmin hate devaripau triśīrṣe hanūmatā śakraparākrameṇa।neduḥ plavaṅgāḥ pracacāla bhūmī rakṣāṁsyatho dudruvire samantāt ।। 6.70.49 ।।

translations.english: Trisira, the enemy of gods, endowed with the prowess of Indra got killed by Hanuman. The earth shook, the monkeys roared and the Rakshasas from all sides took to their heels.
